submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE independent native1254x1254 transparent RGBA sprite. Image1 is the exact Moon Shadow Girl RUN NORTHWEST frame08 edit target. Image2 is a corrected NW15, for its straight/narrow heel-to-toe sole shape ONLY. Image3 is approved project painted style.
LOCAL CORRECTION: redraw only the LOWEST SUPPORT BOOT (anatomical LEFT support leg, boot at screen LOWER-LEFT/below the left half of the pelvis) and its tiny ankle join. Its forefoot currently forms an exaggerated sideways J-hook toward screen-left, visibly deviating from the calf/heel plane. Reduce this lateral yaw/roll: a narrow elongated rear-view boot sole, a smooth lengthwise heel-arch-toe connection, no shoe corner jutting sideways. The visible sole must follow the same backward leg trajectory and NW running plane. Natural ankle pitch remains; do not make a rigid peg leg. Reference2 shows the preferred non-twisted sole but is a DIFFERENT frame/possibly other leg; never copy its pose or leg placement.
Keep this frame's exact support leg and existing phase: frames05-06 are rear propulsion,07-08 are final forefoot push; frames13-16 repeat on opposite leg. Preserve current front-sole ground-contact level, raised heel, knee bend, calf and ankle positions, limb lengths and other leg. Do not make the whole sole flat, lift the planted foot, move the entire body, or switch support to the other foot. Change the small boot silhouette only enough to remove the sideways hook; do not normalize every frame into the same drawing.
LOCK everything else to image1: fullcanvas framing/scale and sprite placement, head and silver hair, ornament, back/NW view, torso lean, hips, both thighs and calves, lifted other boot, navy/gold costume, scarf/tails, two arms, two hands and exactly two crescent daggers. Keep materials and details. No rotation/mirroring/translation/scaling/recentering of whole character. Do not add floor, contact shadow, line, effects, text, checkerboard or background. Keep real transparent alpha, full safe canvas margin, highest available native fidelity.
